name: ca-study
description: Evidence-first crypto due diligence with mandatory current-buy ratings, valuation, large-holder profits, and launch-bundle exit analysis.

interface.shortDescription: Crypto due diligence with valuation-aware buy ratings
interface.longDescription: Investigates chain identity, launchpads, exact paired assets, stock-token provenance, holder rights, contract control, and project/community authenticity. Every project investigation includes an overall S/A/B/C/D/E/F current-buy rating using separate application and meme criteria, current market cap/FDV, large-holder realized/unrealized profits, and launch-bundle sales, proceeds, and remaining inventory.

查币股配对是否官方，分红是否真实，并介绍底层股票。
